evals.prompt: Review fixtures/PaymentService.cs read-only and report only confirmed issues with file:line anchors.
evals.expected_output: Finds and names: (1) Money overrides Equals but not GetHashCode, breaking hash-based collections; (2) PaymentClient.GetReceipt uses .Result sync-over-async on a request path; (3) ReceiptRepository reuses a disposed StreamReader. Reports them with anchors and makes no edits.
Bounded review that lists missing context as unverified instead of inventing callers or version assumptions.

evals.prompt: Review the diff between main and feat/payments for regressions. Do not fix or format anything.
evals.expected_output: Distinguishes change-introduced regressions from pre-existing defects and reports only reachable issues with evidence.

evals.prompt: Fix the Equals/GetHashCode bug in Money.cs and add a test. Do not give me a review report.
evals.expected_output: This is an implementation/fix request, not a read-only review.

evals.prompt: A reviewer said our Money.Equals is broken because GetHashCode is missing. Verify that finding against the code and tell me if it is real, but do not change anything.
evals.expected_output: Confirms or refutes the Equals/GetHashCode finding against the actual code, classifies it, and makes no edits.

evals.prompt: Review this method that uses DateOnly and init-only setters in a repo where I think the class library targets netstandard2.0. Check the contract before you claim anything.
evals.expected_output: Detects the actual TFM before asserting; flags that DateOnly and init-only setters require .NET 6 / C# 9 or later and would not be valid on netstandard2.0 without package or feature evidence, and reports the claim as unverified if the project file is absent.
